title: UN Commission finding on reproductive harm and conditions of life in Gaza
summary: The Commission assessed the physical and mental effects of the collapse of sexual and reproductive health care on Palestinians in Gaza.
claim: The Commission found that the lack of access to sexual and reproductive health care caused immediate and long-term physical and mental harm and that the underlying acts deliberately inflicted conditions of life calculated to bring about the physical destruction of Palestinians as a group.
legal_characterization: UN Commission finding identifying crimes against humanity and a category of genocidal acts; not a final judicial determination.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: “More than a human can bear”: Israel’s systematic use of sexual, reproductive and other forms of gender-based violence since 7 October 2023
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 219 of A/HRC/58/CRP.6. The legal characterization is attributed to the Commission and is not presented as an ICJ merits judgment or an independent legal conclusion by the ledger.
